Then he set the paper on the windowsill, where the morning light could reach it, and he stood a long while watching the gray waves fold and unfold beneath his tower, keeping the stranger's memory alive.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝的梦里。街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下湿漉漉的回声。早点铺的窗口亮起第一盏灯，白汽从蒸笼里升起。清洁工挥动扫帚，沙沙声在寂静中格外清晰。高楼的玻璃映着将明未明的天光，像无数双半睁的眼睛。这是城市最温柔的时刻，疲惫与希望在黎明前短暂地交汇，等待又一个白昼醒来。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n• Like standing between two mirrors, each reflection holds a tinier version inside it.\n• It stops when the problem gets so small there is an easy answer, so it does not go on forever."}
